primordial-state.text: Chaos comes first, followed by Gaia, Tartarus and Eros.
primordial-state.label: PRIMARY SOURCE

first-actors.text: Chaos, Gaia, Tartarus and Eros; Gaia later bears Ouranos.
first-actors.label: PRIMARY SOURCE

creation-order.text: Divine generation and struggles over rule organize the genealogy.
creation-order.label: PRIMARY SOURCE

human-creation.text: The first woman is fashioned at Zeus’s command; this passage is not a full origin of humanity.
human-creation.label: PRIMARY SOURCE

divine-structure.text: Kronos attacks Ouranos; Zeus’s generation later fights the Titans.
divine-structure.label: PRIMARY SOURCE

knowledge-mortality.text: Prometheus steals fire; Zeus responds by arranging the making of the woman.
knowledge-mortality.label: PRIMARY SOURCE
